card.name: Words just before "clinical significance"
card.fires_on: Small words like "of", "be" or "significant" right before "clinical" in drug-interaction sentences saying an effect is not likely or of unknown clinical relevance.

modes.label: Hedged interaction findings
modes.description: Linking words such as "be" or "of" after "not likely to" or "not considered to", just before clinically significant or relevant.
modes.example: The change in furosemide clearance value is not likely to<< be>> clinically significant.

modes.label: Other slot before clinical
modes.description: Words such as "unknown" or "significant" where the next word is likely to be clinical.
modes.example: This change is of<< unknown>> clinical significance.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing "clin" or "clinical" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is about to say that an interaction is or is not clinically significant.
